summary: Comprehensive backend (25 pytest tests, 100% pass) and frontend (Playwright E2E) testing for FinNota invoice ledger. All critical flows pass: login (+ wrong-password error), master data CRUD + CSV import, nota creation with jenis auto-derivation and auto-computed totals, nota list, laporan pendapatan-pengeluaran, laporan item-per-sumber-dana, user management with role enforcement (403 for non-admin on /api/users).

minor.issue: Returns 200 even when user_id is invalid/not found; no 404 handling
Returns 200 even when nota does not exist (no 404)
No validation that same kode/nama is unique (duplicate kode rekening can be created)

action_items: (Optional) Add 404 handling to PUT /api/users/{id} and DELETE /api/nota/{id} when the resource does not exist.
(Optional) Enforce unique constraint on kode rekening 'kode' to prevent duplicates.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PUT /users/{id} and DELETE /nota/{id} silently succeed on missing records; should return 404.
server.py: _nota_filter stores an empty $gte/$lte range dict ({}) when both start/end are None but the outer 'if start or end' already guards this — OK.
server.py: Master CSV import defaults kode-rekening jenis to 'pengeluaran' when invalid — behaviour documented but may surprise users.
CORS: allow_origins uses explicit FRONTEND_URL + localhost — good, works with credentials.
Auth cookie uses SameSite=none; Secure=true — correct for cross-origin preview; httpOnly set.
No brute-force lockout / rate-limit on /auth/login (not required by spec but a security consideration).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_* prefixed master/nota/user data and clean up at the end. UI test data (UI-*) was cleaned up via the API after the Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (25 tests, parallel-safe). Covers auth, master CRUD + CSV import, nota create/list/get/filter, 3 reports endpoints, user mgmt + 403 role enforcement. Playwright E2E verified: login error path, master data create (incl. jenis select), item barang, nota auto-total (unit*harga = Rp 20.000 for 4x5000, then Rp 36.000 after adding manual item 2x8000), jenis auto-derivation from kode rekening, nota listing in daftar-nota, laporan showing the newly created nota, and manajemen user page accessible to admin. No critical bugs found.
